description: Switch thrown under a train running facing through it (#289 review 2b): as eu07_td_switch_facing_control, but the way is set to track 2 (keyctrl01) and zwr01 is thrown to track 1 when the locomotive has run onto the switch with both its bogies (event of the switch track, set off by its rear axle). The locomotive and the train behind it have to go on to track 1 and stay on the rails, and the AI has to stop before the signal at stop on track 1.

trainsets: node -1 0 {{vehicle}}_c1 dynamic pkp\bdhpumn_v3 bdhpumn_50512608068-6 BDHPUMN_TAPICERKA_1 0 nobody 3 0 enddynamic
node -1 0 {{vehicle}}_c2 dynamic pkp\bdhpumn_v3 bdhpumn_50512608068-6 BDHPUMN_TAPICERKA_1 0 nobody 3 0 enddynamic
node -1 0 {{vehicle}}_c3 dynamic pkp\bdhpumn_v3 bdhpumn_50512608068-6 BDHPUMN_TAPICERKA_1 0 nobody 0 0 enddynamic
vars.route: node -1 0 autotest_route_launcher eventlauncher 0 0 0 -1 none 1034 keyctrl01 end

xfail: #289 review 2b, as before the stack (TrkFoll reverted in c268673c): an axle keeps the way of the switch it ran onto but leaves by the way the switch is set to now, so the locomotive jumps 1.9 m sideways at the end of the switch, an axle at a time; and the AI keeps the route it scanned before the throw (a switch behind the head of the train is not scanned again), so on track 1 it brakes for the exit signal of track 2 and runs past the signal at stop of track 1 at 40 km/h
